criteria.why_strict_is_low: 91% of account-months show exactly one transaction inside the sampled windows and 95% are active in a single window, so multi-contract behavior is rarely observable; no cluster reaches a median of two contracts

name_only_baseline.reading: if the clustering share tracks the name-only share closely, the behavioral model adds little beyond the name class in these sparse windows

inclusion_probability_weighting.reading: a sensitivity under stated assumptions, not a demonstrated correction of the observation bias
assumptions: each account's per-window activity probability is constant over the month and estimated from the same windows that observe it
windows are independent draws for every account; the fixed 03:00/15:00 UTC design is treated as if it were random
accounts never seen in any window have no weight: the index covers observed accounts only
heterogeneity between accounts beyond activity frequency is ignored
inclusion_probability_weighting.validation: checked within six days against 24 hourly windows of the same design (inclusion_from_intraday_days); the month-level bias of the share is still not identified

design.selection: the three motivating and the three validation days of the volume reconciliation; not chosen for this measurement

inclusion_from_intraday_days.reading: inclusion is the share of a day's 24-window accounts that the two fixed windows observe; it rises with activity, so light accounts are under-observed and the sampled population is tilted toward frequent signers. The name-only share under the two designs shows how much the composition shifts; the weighting check tells whether the inclusion weighting used as a sensitivity moves the two-window share toward the 24-window share. Within-day inclusion on six days is an observed quantity; it does not identify the month-level bias of the QAA share, which would need a fuller observation of whole months
inclusion_from_intraday_days.kind: observed (within-day, six days), used as a check of the weighting sensitivity

rule.declared: 2026-11-08, before the first full month was read from BigQuery
rule.population: every signer of at least one transaction in the month, from bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions (the committed QAA months; none chosen by result)
checks: inclusion of the two-window design: accounts observed in the sampled windows over all accounts active in the month
composition by name class and the name-only quality share, full month against sampled windows and against the inclusion-weighted sampled share
share of accounts with a single transaction and with at least two distinct receivers, full month against sampled windows
rule.limits: the behavioral clustering is not refitted on full months here: its features are defined inside 50-block windows and the committed assignment is the baseline; this validation measures the population the sampled share describes, not a new QAA level

full_month_validation.reading: over 24 months the two fixed windows observe a median 0.10% of the month's signers, and the month holds a median 2.9 times the mean daily active accounts that the QAA count rescales; the name-only quality share computed on the sampled windows sits -3.2% (median; range -42.8% to +47.8%) from the full-month share and the inclusion weighting leaves -4.9%, moving toward the full month in 8 of 24 months: the design bias is large, varies in sign across months and is not corrected by the weighting; the population share of the sampled windows is not identified by this design, and the QAA count (share times mean daily actives) is not a count of quality accounts in the monthly population
full_month_validation.kind: observed (full-month population from BigQuery against the sampled windows)

by_window_hour.reading: shares computed separately on accounts observed in each fixed window

model_agreement.reading: the two models label the same months differently; the level of the share depends on the model, its trend less so

variants.variant: committed hyper-parameters refitted on this machine
Gaussian mixture, diagonal covariance, BIC-selected k in 3..8

refits.reading: the committed assignment is the baseline; these refits show how much the latest default share and the partition itself depend on hyper-parameters and on the algorithm. Computed by `make qaa-refits` on one machine (HDBSCAN assignments are platform-dependent) and committed as a sensitivity artifact; not regenerated by the build

scope.observed_unit: accounts signing at least one transaction inside the sampled windows
scope.population_extrapolation: the QAA count multiplies the sampled share by NearBlocks mean daily active accounts; inclusion probability rises with activity, so the count is an illustrative rescaling and the share is the measured quantity
scope.identity: no verified human or bot labels exist; groups are behavioral patterns

not_done: a clustering refit on full-month features (the committed window-based assignment stays the baseline)
